# Test fixtures

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plain_parts.step` | Three parts (`RedBox` 20 mm cube, `BlueCyl` r5 x 30 mm at x = 40, `TwoTone` 10 mm cube at y = 40), exported by FreeCAD 1.1 `Import.export` with no colours. |
| `colored_parts.step` | The same file with STEP colour entities added: `RedBox` red and `BlueCyl` blue on their solids, `TwoTone` green with its last face (the top) yellow. FreeCAD's console mode cannot write colours, so they were appended as `COLOUR_RGB` / `STYLED_ITEM` entities in a `MECHANICAL_DESIGN_GEOMETRIC_PRESENTATION_REPRESENTATION`, the way CAD programs write them. |
| `block.igs` | A 10 x 20 x 30 mm box, written by FreeCAD 1.1 `Part.makeBox(10, 20, 30).exportIges(...)`. |

The mesh fixtures (STL, OBJ, PLY, glTF, FBX, 3MF) are generated by `test_import.py` itself.
